title: Full AI System to Control All CAD Softwares + Generate Every CAD File on H: Drive
description: Build a full AI system that can drive every CAD application used on the H: drive through a single prism_ai entry point, and can GENERATE (not just read) every CAD file format found on disk. Coverage ground truth is CAD_COVERAGE_MATRIX.json, which must auto-refresh so newly-appearing file formats are detected without manual rebuild.

ingestion_plan.problem: New CAD files and new extensions appear on H: drive over time (customer adds, acquisitions, new CAD apps). The matrix must not go stale.

mechanisms.name: cad-coverage-auto-refresh
mechanisms.description: SessionStart hook re-runs build-cad-coverage-matrix.ts if the existing matrix is >24h old OR if the newest file in JM DIE is newer than matrix.generatedAt. Debounced, <5s scan time.

mechanisms.name: unknown-extension-detector
mechanisms.description: When scanner sees an extension NOT in CAD_EXTENSIONS set, log it to UNKNOWN_CAD_EXTENSIONS.jsonl with sample file paths. Hook surfaces this on SessionStart so the AI is forced to decide: classify as CAD (add to taxonomy + build bridge) or mark as non-CAD.

mechanisms.name: new-customer-directory-watcher
mechanisms.description: When JM DIE/ gains a new customer subfolder, scan it immediately, append summary to CUSTOMER_CAD_CATALOG.jsonl. Does not block other work; runs via Stop hook debounced.

mechanisms.name: volume-delta-alert
mechanisms.description: If a scan finds >5% volume change in any extension vs last matrix, emit a structured alert to AGENT_CHAT.md so concurrent sessions know the ground truth shifted.
